The '''Epistle of Marka Ragnos''' was an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] document, presumably authored by [[Marka Ragnos]] sometime before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The last known copy of the epistle was destroyed by [[Celeste Morne]] at some point prior to [[3963 BBY]].
